{{Quote|It took 85 men less than an hour to bring so much chaos and disarray to Ebenmal that the defenders&mdash;over 3,000 Rebels&mdash;surrendered.|''Imperial Atrocities and Other Noble Pursuits'', by Chen Ming-di|<ref name="Jumptrooper" />}}
A '''battle''' was fought on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Ebenmal]] at some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. A group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]], consisting of eighty-five [[Jumptrooper/Legends|jumptroopers]], attacked the [[Citadel of Ebenmal]]. Over three thousand [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rebel trooper/Legends|soldiers]] attempted to defend the ancient structure, but the Imperials were able to gain the upper hand and capture the Citadel. The Rebels, in turn, surrendered to the Jumptroopers, bringing the battle to a close in one [[Standard hour/Legends|hour's]] [[Time/Legends|time]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|The attack did not come from the ground, it came from above. Just before dawn, a stratospheric freighter released 85 of the prototype jumptroopers, who floated, serenely and unnoticed, down to the Citadel.|''Imperial Atrocities and Other Noble Pursuits'', by Chen Ming-di|<ref name="Jumptrooper" />}}
Sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Explain" /> a battle was fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at the [[Citadel of Ebenmal]] on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Ebenmal]]. Early in the morning, a group of eighty-five prototype [[Jumptrooper/Legends|Imperial jumptroopers]] exited a [[Unidentified stratospheric freighter|stratospheric freighter]] unnoticed. The [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] proceeded to attack the Citadel of Ebenmal, hitting the communications tower, rear ammo dumps, [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] supplies, and eventually the [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]]. Although the defenders&mdash;over three thousand [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel soldiers]]&mdash;attempted to stop them several [[Time/Legends|times]] during the conflict, the Imperial jumptroopers merely used their [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] to escape the Rebels in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]].<ref name="Jumptrooper" />

It had been said that the Citadel of Ebenmal had stood for over ten thousand years without falling to invasion. However, by the end of the one-[[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] battle, the Citadel of Ebenmal had been taken by the Empire. In addition, in excess of three thousand of the Rebels present surrendered to the Imperials. The battle and other subsequent information was later mentioned by the military [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Chen Ming-di]] in ''[[Imperial Atrocities and Other Noble Pursuits]]''.<ref name="Jumptrooper" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle fought on Ebenmal was first mentioned in the "Jumptrooper" databank entry in the [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] versions of the [[2010]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.<ref name="Jumptrooper" />
